daily.full:
共識

今日共同看好最集中的是$TSLA，6個帳號明確看多，相關帖文20則。@TrendSpider稱演算法對$TSLA發出下一入場信號，策略回報102%對比買入持有79%。原帖 @WallStJesus轉發@FuzionTrader，指Net Sweeper Flow翻轉後未回頭。原帖 @OptionsHawk表示衝破近期高點，熱門看漲期權走勢不錯。原帖

$PLTR有4個帳號看多、相關帖文24則。@amitisinvesting讚揚收入增長96%、調整後營業利潤率62%，美國商業收入首次超過政府、同比+148%。原帖 @StockSavvyShay反駁「美國商業由149%略降至148%即放緩」說法，指總營收由93%加速至96%。原帖 @TrendSpider強調美國商業+148%、政府+96%，並引用第三季雙超與上調指引。原帖

$AAPL亦有4個帳號看多、相關帖文21則。@TrendSpider報道第四季盈收雙超：EPS 2.10美元對預期1.98、營收1144.77億對預期1133.92億。原帖 @munster_gene指投資者錯過更大重點：12月收入指引優於華爾街預期。原帖 @MarkNewtonCMT稱短期動能不穩，但較大趨勢仍穩健。原帖

共同看淡以$ORCL為首（3個帳號、8則帖文）。@KobeissiLetter指宣佈透過股權及債務發行籌集200億美元資助AI建設後，股價跌逾5%，較今年高位跌54%。原帖 @KeithMcCullough諷刺上週追高者「痛啊」。原帖 @RedDogT3稱過去一年左右一直是災難。原帖

分歧

最大分歧在$LITE：1個帳號看多、3個看淡，相關帖文26則，焦點是$MRVL收購。@michaelsikand認為$LITE價值遠超1000美元、不賣出，並稱對光子學整體看漲。原帖 @amitisinvesting指全股票交易嚴重稀釋、2028年才交割，執行長稱產能售至2029年卻決定賣出。原帖 @garyblack00警告應觀察以較10/28收盤溢價24%（約每股1132美元）提出收購後的股價反應。原帖

$INTC亦呈分歧（1多3淡、12則）。@Mr_Derivatives試圖「意志成底部」；@KeithMcCullough稱散戶多頭正在被清洗。原帖

結構

窗口內71個帳號、304則帖文（原創278、轉發26）；明確立場帳號40個，看多觀點123、看淡56。共同看好標的共11檔、共同看淡3檔、分歧15檔。提及最多包括$AAPL（21則／16帳號）、$QQQ與$LITE（各26則）。AI供應鏈併購與財報後分化並行，指數方向不如個股共識清晰。

daily.full:
Consensus

Clearest common bullish today is $TSLA, with 6 accounts long and 20 related posts. @TrendSpider said its algorithm just issued the next entry signal, strategy +102% vs buy-and-hold +79%. post @WallStJesus reshared @FuzionTrader that Net Sweeper Flow flipped and has not looked back. post @OptionsHawk said it broke recent highs with hot call action. post

$PLTR has 4 accounts long and 24 related posts. @amitisinvesting praised revenue +96%, adjusted operating margin 62%, U.S. commercial revenue topping government for the first time at +148% YoY. post @StockSavvyShay pushed back on “slowing” from 149% to 148% U.S. commercial, noting total revenue accelerated from 93% to 96%. post @TrendSpider highlighted U.S. commercial +148% and government +96% with a beat and raised guide. post

$AAPL also has 4 accounts long and 21 related posts. @TrendSpider reported Q4 beat: EPS $2.10 vs $1.98 expected, revenue $114.477B vs $113.392B. post @munster_gene said investors missed the bigger point: December revenue guidance above Wall Street. post @MarkNewtonCMT called near-term momentum shaky but the larger trend still intact. post

Common bearish led by $ORCL (3 accounts, 8 posts). @KobeissiLetter said shares fell over 5% after plans to raise $20B via equity and debt for AI buildout, down 54% from the year’s high. post @KeithMcCullough needled last week’s chase buyers. post @RedDogT3 called the past year or so a disaster. post

Divergence

Biggest split is $LITE: 1 long / 3 short, 26 related posts, centered on the $MRVL deal. @michaelsikand argued $LITE is worth well over $1,000 and would not sell, calling it bullish for photonics overall. post @amitisinvesting called the all-stock deal badly dilutive with a 2028 close, while capacity is sold through 2029. post @garyblack00 warned bulls to watch the reaction after a ~24% premium to the 10/28 close (~$1,132/share). post

$INTC is also split (1 long / 3 short, 12 posts). @Mr_Derivatives is trying to will a bottom; @KeithMcCullough said retail longs are being washed out. post

Structure

Window: 71 accounts, 304 posts (278 originals, 26 reposts); 40 accounts with a clear stance, 123 bullish views vs 56 bearish. 11 common-bull tickers, 3 common-bear, 15 split. Most mentioned include $AAPL (21 posts / 16 accounts), $QQQ and $LITE (26 each). AI-supply-chain M&A and post-earnings dispersion dominate; index direction is less clear than single-name consensus.
